item.title: Suspect Arrested After Sullivan Police Shooting
item.description: The man involved in last month’s officer-involved shooting in Sullivan is now in custody. The Sullivan County Sheriff’s Department says 31-year-old Kylan Holbert was released from an Indianapolis hospital and taken into custody by Indiana State Police.
